Background The Regional Programme for Africa is a flagship continental programme of the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), implemented through the Regional Service Center for Africa (RSCA), designed to respond to the evolving challenges and opportunities across African. It is anchored in the African Union (AU) Agenda 2063, including its Second Ten-Year Implementation Plan, and aligned with the UNDP Strategic Plan 2026-2029. The programme complements national development efforts by leveraging regional institutions, partnerships and platforms to address transboundary challenges, unlock shared opportunities and scale impact. The Africa Facility to Support Inclusive Transitions (AFSIT), a flagship joint initiative of the African Union Commission (AUC) and UNDP, was established in response to the call made by the AU Heads of State and Government during the 16th Extraordinary Session on Terrorism and Unconstitutional Change of Government (UCG) in Africa, held on May 28, 2023, in Malabo, Equatorial Guinea. The Heads of State and Government called for collective action and solidarity to develop robust response mechanisms to UCGs, deepening democracy, and collective security on the continent. AFSIT provides integrated programmatic support to countries navigating complex political transitions. The Facility adopts a development-oriented approach aimed at strengthening governance structures, promoting stability, and building resilience, ensuring that transitions are peaceful and sustainable. It places strong emphasis on inclusivity, empowering civil society organizations (CSOs) and amplifying the leadership and meaningful participation of women, youth, and marginalized groups in political processes and decision-making. AFSIT also plays a vital role in knowledge development, generating insights and best practices to inform decision-making and strengthen transition processes across the continent. Position Purpose The Programme Analyst will report to the AFSIT Programme Specialist within the UNDP Regional Service Centre for Africa (RSCA) and work closely with UNDP Country Offices, regional institutions, and development partners involved in programme implementation. The AFSIT Team Is Seeking a Programme Analyst (P2) To Support The Implementation, Coordination, Monitoring, And Reporting Of The Africa Facility To Support Inclusive Transitions (AFSIT Programme. In Particular The Programme Analyst Will Lead The Delivery Of The Following Projects Under AFSIT Building Resilience and Inclusive Development for Governance and Equality (BRIDGE), which aims to promote gender-responsive, transparent and accountable governance systems while advancing women’s leadership and participation in decision-making processes. Implemented in Guinea-Bissau, South Sudan and The Gambia.
